dialogues.text: Each player starts with differently colored kuuhenki. Each round, they draw one kuuhenki from their opponent.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: When a player has two kuuhenki of the same color, they make a pair and can be discarded. Any that can't form a pair must be kept.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The round ends when a player can't form any more kuuhenki pairs, and that player gets a sticker.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Can four people play as well?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: That is fine, so long as the turn order is fixed beforehand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty then! In that case, the two of us will join as one team!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay... but if you lose, you're both getting stickered! I don't wanna hear any excuses.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure. And if we win?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: If you win... only one of you gets to sticker someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I have taken to calling this "Aino logic."

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hey, lay off me, alright? Okay, so we're starting the game from scratch again, which means all my stickers so far don't count!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Luonnotar is the Kuuhenki of honor for this game. Anyway, let's go clockwise, starting from Ineffa.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Let me pick a good one... Hmm, what's it gonna be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're looking very pleased with yourself there... What happened to being a huge grumposaurus?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmph, I won. Duh.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Argh! Me again!?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Don't fidget too much, Aino, or the sticker's going to fall off.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I don't care! If it falls off, it falls off!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: If a pair of kuuhenki get discarded, why not a pair of stickers, huh? Huh?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I've lost.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Sticker! Sticker! Sticker!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Cute!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: You think so? Shame, I can't see it for myself.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Uhhh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What did Luonnotar say?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: She said it looks so cute that she wants me to lose a few more rounds...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After many more rounds, everyone's heads are covered in stickers...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Except for one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who put these stickers on Paimon's eyebrows? Ugh... She can barely see...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Alright, now I think we've got enough evidence to prove that there's a serious problem here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Agreed.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes. I agree as well.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: The culprit is... Ineffa!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Culprit? What did I do?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Quit acting dumb, Ineffa! You're not wriggling your way outta this one. I've been watching you!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Not only did you remember whose side Luonnotar started at, but every time someone drew a kuuhenki, you were logging it and calculating every last possibility...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Which kuuhenki pairs were gone, who had what color kuuhenki in their hand, even our facial expressions... You were keeping track of it the entire time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly! What Aino said!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Putting aside the fact that running calculations is not against the game rules... Do you have any evidence to support your allegations?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: But that's not against the rules, either...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: So, she admits it!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: She certainly does.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Alright, everyone grab a sticker! It's time to get Ineffa back!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: But—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Take that!

dialogues.speaker: View Moon-Prayer Slip
dialogues.text: "I wish that all who dwell in this moonlit world can find a place to belong, and I wish that I shall one day see my friends again."

dialogues.speaker: View Moon-Prayer Slip
dialogues.text: "If only Miss Lyylikki would notice me..."

dialogues.speaker: View Moon-Prayer Slip
dialogues.text: "I really hope my boss gives me a raise..."

dialogues.speaker: View Moon-Prayer Slip
dialogues.text: "I want to adapt to human society more quickly."

dialogues.speaker: View Moon-Prayer Slip
dialogues.text: #"Hope things go smoothly on the journey with {NICKNAME}, and that Columbina's travel goes well too."

dialogues.speaker: View Moon-Prayer Slip
dialogues.text: "I wish that the Longplume Ibises would stop biting me."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Viewing

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Happy Moon-Prayer Night, adventurers. May you have a lovely evening.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: I've seen Lyney and the other children play this game before. It would seem that it's not a bad way to relax once in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Candy? Huh. Would you mind if I took a handful extra? I'm sure the children will enjoy them.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: I must say, Columbina, you really have changed. You never used to show this much consideration for other people, even when prompted.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: I'm sure Sandrone would agree when I say... I like the present version of you better.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Heh. That was fun. It's a shame Ashru doesn't like playing with water, or I'd have roped him in as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Oh? A gift? You shouldn't have, Miss Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Mmm... Very nice indeed. Candy is one of many luxuries that the desert folk could never afford.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How I yearned for candy when I could not have it... Yet, now that it is readily available to me, I never seem to crave it.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: May your Moon-Prayer Night be one free from regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Phew... I just had a water fight with two Fatui Harbingers... Pretty scary... But also surprisingly fun.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Aw man, this feels kinda wrong... Like, shouldn't we be the ones giving you candy rather than the other way around?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Um... I... I guess I'll just... take one.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Ugh! What flavor is that!?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (It tastes like... getting a mouthful of muddy grass... after being rear-ended by a Blunthorn Rhino, then face planting the ground...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (...Ugh, I'll never get this taste out of my mouth...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I—It's delicious, ahaha... Mmm...

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: Welcome home, Moon Goddess. Would you like to try on some animal-themed headwear?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: (Which one should I try?)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Try black cat ears...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: (Should I keep wearing it?)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I'll keep it on.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Something about festive lighting always has a way of putting the warmest smiles on people's faces.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: This is most thoughtful of you, Miss Columbina. Kindness exudes from your heart like benevolent moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Forgive me, but I shall have to enjoy this gift a little later. I hope that the flavor I chose is not the only one of its kind.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: If others were denied the chance to sample such kindness as you have shown to me, it would be a great pity indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Yes. May everyone's wishes come true...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Why, thank you... Don't mind if I do.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Oh my. It's so sweet...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm so accustomed to plain, simple meals that this sweet treat is quite a shock to the senses...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: But I savor this moment in its entirety, because... It tastes like true friendship.

dialogues.speaker: Jacek
dialogues.text: Dodoco's Whirly Gig! Come ride on a soft and furry Dodoco, and embark on an unforgettable adventure!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I'd like to go again...

dialogues.speaker: Jacek
dialogues.text: Of course, Moon Goddess. This way, please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fun ride, huh? You and Columbina looked pretty sad to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... This isn't gonna make Paimon dizzy, is it...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, candy for us? Thanks a bunch, Columbina! Don't mind if we do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, this one's intense! Mmm, but it's sooo tasty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What about you, {NICKNAME}? How does yours taste?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Like Smetana, I think... A very novel flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds good! Paimon's drooling now... Are there any more Smetana candies in the box?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes, I believe so.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kay, gotcha. Let's see...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you tried any of them yourself?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, could you pick out three Smetana-flavored candies?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This one, and... Yep, this one looks right, too... Okay, that's three!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here we go. One per person!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All together, then?

dialogues.speaker: All Three Together
dialogues.text: It's so sweet!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: A soft and furry creature that bounces and jumps...

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: Welcome home, Moon Goddess.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, this one talks, too...

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: Ahem. Allow me to introduce myself. I am a Dodoco from a distant archipelago — the most mischievous of all my Dodo-brothers and Dodo-sisters!

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: When the going got tough, I powered through, and when I met obstacles, I boomed them away!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: That sounds like a lot of fun.

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: Doesn't it just! Ah, but then the trouble started.

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: Recently, I found a lovely beach, the same, beautiful jelly color as my hometown, and so I dove in to have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: Only to find it overgrown with seagrass, and nasty little Spikey Fish everywhere, looking to turn me into a Dodoco kebab...

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: I made it back to shore by the skin of my teeth, but my tail tail was sorely hurt!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Couldn't you just... boom them away?

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: Oh, I wanted to, believe me! But I've heard that you, Moon Goddess, can understand animal-speech.

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: The last thing I wanted was cause a gigantic fuss and get taken to court by a school of Spikey Fish. I'd be driven out of these waters for good! And my winter holiday would be ruined!

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: And so, dear Moon Goddess, I was wondering if you might lend me your allegiance...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Are you roping me into a crime?

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Dodoco
dialogues.text: Ahaha! Let's call it a once-in-a-lifetime, carefree adventure. Does that sound better?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: All the festival-goers tonight are dressed up as the Moon Goddess. But there's nothing to say that the Moon Goddess can't disguise herself as a Dodoco, is there?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Besides, this is your home. You should be free to be whoever you wish.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I'm not well acquainted with Dodocos, Madame Mage...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Oh, that's quite alright! We Dodocos are innocent, happy creatures with a free-spirited nature.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Many, like myself, are mischievous troublemakers. Others are lazy souls who like nothing better than to lie down on a nice rock and take a nap.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: In our eyes, every creature who yearns for happiness and freedom is a Dodoco!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: But perhaps in yours, we Dodoco are... a fluffier and more mischievous breed of kuuhenki?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes, that is a much easier image to follow.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Then let's play. Grab onto my tail tail, and follow me into the sea! Time to settle some scores with the bad guys!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Up for another round of fish blast— I mean, of bye-bye bad fishies?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes. Hello there. I am the Moon Dodo-Goddess.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Wonderful! It's Dodoventure time!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Oh me, oh my! With your help, Miss Columbina, we've blown every last blade of annoying seagrass and each nasty Spikey Fish out of the water!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: You truly are a kind-hearted Moon Goddess! At last, I am free to enjoy myself once more in these waters.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: I hope we meet again at the next festival!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I don't suppose you'd... like to play again, by any chance...?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong, once is plenty. You're under no obligation to indulge me any further... and besides, I don't have any other prizes for you...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll play again. This is fun.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Great! I mean, if you say so...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Is it really all that much fun, though? Huh. My tastes must be falling seriously out of step with the majority...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: It'd be rude to just leave without saying anything... But at the same time, I don't wanna barge into their lively conversation just to announce that I'm leaving... Eh, I guess I'll just wait a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Albedo?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This sketch is for you, Grand Master.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Oh? A gift for me? Thanks. Let's see what you've done for me...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The North Wind, Left in the Lurch.

choices.text: Mr. Albedo, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Mm... It seems I've picked lemon. It strikes a good balance between sweet and sour.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This has piqued my curiosity. What if we were to add citrus and other spices, then enhance the flavor via caramelization? I wonder what the end product would be like?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Perhaps I should take the time to try this out.

choices.text: Mr. Varka, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Ooh, I get one too? Nice! Thanks.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Mm, what is that? So familiar... Don't tell me, don't tell me... Oh, I got it! It's like the candy jar dropped into a vat of "Today's Boon"!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Seems I'm a proud recipient of today's Feast of the Moon, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: The "Death" card made a most enigmatic appearance...

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: The moon for which Miss Columbina is bound... I fear...

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: ...Fretting is of no avail. I will have a chat with Alice about it sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: Ah, you're such a polite child, Miss Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: But we elders have already partaken of our fair share of stories in this world. Enjoying candy, keeping up with the hip and groovy trends of the day... these things should be left to youngsters like you.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: I hope you don't misunderstand me — I do not intend to lecture you, or reject your kindness.

dialogues.speaker: Barbeloth
dialogues.text: It is simply that... the mere sight of this candy is starting to give me a toothache.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Done being a do-gooder yet?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Thanks for coming here with me, Hat Guy.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Are there any games you'd like to play? It's your turn to pick. I'll come with you.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: ...Why does that hamster think you've grown up? You haven't changed at all.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I know you don't mean that. You're just taking the opportunity to make fun of me, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Even if you won't admit that taking some time to compose yourself is important, I can see that you're doing it in practice.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Otherwise, you'd have taken off your hat and flown away by now.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Looks like Albedo's socialization program has been far more useful to you than all those Vahumana textbooks.

choices.text: Durin, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: A Moon-Prayer Candy for me? Thank you...

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: It smells like... baked apples and butter.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Reminds me of Good Hunter, a restaurant in Mondstadt... I always have to resist the temptation to go there, unless I'm ordering food.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: I understand your homesickness, Miss Columbina. I have a double dose of it...

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Because both Simulanka and Mondstadt are my home.

choices.text: Hat Guy, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: I thought you'd spend your precious time doing something more worthwhile.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Everyone has to take one? Well, fine. I'll take mine.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: If all the prizes are gone, I might as well close up shop for the day. But you haven't had your fill of fun yet, right?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: So, the next time a customer shows up, you're going to have to run faster, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: And remember — run out of the rings, not into them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Oho? A gift, for me? Ah, Lord Sangemah Bay really is going up in the world!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: (Wow, candy from the Moon Goddess herself! If I bagged this up... no, what am I saying — boxed this up, in exquisite gift boxes... Yes! I could make a fortune!!!)

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: (Hmm... Maybe I don't even need to go to all that trouble. Any old boxes will do — I just need to tell my customers that this candy is blessed by the Moon Goddess. Yeah, that oughtta do it...)

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: (Hehe, sounds like a plan. Time to have Urwa earn his keep when I get back...)

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: What's there to see on that moon, anyway...?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph, let her go up there and cry alone. See if I care...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You're giving me candy? ...That isn't like you. This had better not be some weird prank...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmm... coffee flavor? I thought you hated coffee... Mm, it's extra-strong, too. Hah! You didn't do all this just for me, did you...?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hey, hey! Don't take it away! I never said I didn't want it. I mean, you can't unmake the candy now...

dialogues.speaker: Limppu
dialogues.text: Assorted Moon-Prayer Candy! All your favorite flavors in a box! Alright, kids, just line up over here...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmph. I'm never playing games with you ever again, Ineffa!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino is throwing a tantrum again... I believe it will take three krumkakes to constitute a suitable peace offering.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ooh, Moon-Prayer Candy! Sweet! Is it okay if I grab a whole bunch?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Psst, Columbina, turn around! Use your huge cloak to block Ineffa's vision!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yum! Ooh, and this one's even yummier...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ugh... The flavors are blending in my mouth... Eww...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Scanning candy composition and ingredient ratios...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Selection confirmed. I would like the krumkake-flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...Flavor profile simulates real krumkakes with 27% accuracy. This is a non-viable substitute for Aino's afternoon snack.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: One moment, please.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Done. Please sample this freshly-baked krumkake, Miss Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...Ugh. I really thought you were gonna send me home...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Where did you learn to scare people, huh? Bad! Bad Ineffa!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Do you see this, Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's a krumkake! You made it yourself, didn't you? Wait. How did you know I was hungry?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Correction: You are not hungry. You merely desire food.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: However, consuming extraneous snacks is acceptable during a festival. Come, celebrate Moon-Prayer Night, Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yay! You're the best, Ineffa! Festivals. Are. Awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Chestnut
dialogues.text: C'mon, Citrus, one more round! Just one more!

dialogues.speaker: Citrus
dialogues.text: But my neck— ah! Oof... It's acting up again...

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: You should take a break. Health comes first.

dialogues.speaker: Cranberry
dialogues.text: Yeah, don't push yourself. We'll find someone else!

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Hey, don't look at me. I'm just the referee.

dialogues.speaker: Chestnut
dialogues.text: What are we gonna do, then?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Do you need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Cranberry
dialogues.text: Yes we do. We need one more player for our game.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Alright. Could you teach me how to play?

dialogues.speaker: Cranberry
dialogues.text: It's really simple. You just throw the dice and move by that number of tiles. First one to reach the finish line wins.

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Rolling a hamster means you move one step forward, a paper frog is two steps, and a flying squirrel is three steps — 'cuz they go the fastest.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Okay, I get it.

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: So we're all set?

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: In that case, please take your places... and let the game begin!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: (What is going on over here? It looks like fun...)

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Hold it right there! You can't run away from me, Moon Goddess!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are you talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Of course! Do you see anyone else here dressed up as the moon goddess besides me and you? Hey, c'mon, call me by my title!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Happy Moon-Prayer Night, Moon Goddess.

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Hehe, and the same to you!

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Anyway, there's no time to waste. Get ready... for the duel of a lifetime!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Um... a duel?

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Meet my partner, Stacko. Come on out, Stacko!

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Don't just stand there! Let's see your partner!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Partner...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Pee-weeet!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm? ...So I need to select a partner and command them in battle?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Partner... I need a partner...

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Beep.

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Whoa, am I seeing things? Where'd you get a kuuhenki!? They're super rare!

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: That's great — buuuut, you can only bring one partner to battle against me and Stacko. No ganging up allowed!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: (They all look so eager to be picked... Hmm... Which one should I choose?)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The light and floaty kuuhenki.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: (This one usually lives in Nasha Town. She likes falling asleep to the sound of striking hammers... And I bet she's quite familiar with robots' weak spots.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Testing, testing... This is an emergency broadcast — an exciting battle is about to take place right here at the Nasha Town special arena!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: In this corner, we have the Moon Goddess and her robot partner...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her kuuhenki partner.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her Rimehorn Deer partner.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her... other robot partner.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Gah, this announcer stuff is harder than I thought! Why does everything I say sound so dumb? If I could cringe any harder, I'd fold in on myself!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Only one Moon Goddess can be victorious in this ultimate battle of destiny! But who will it be? There's only one way to find out!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Now, without further ado... Let the battle of the moons begin!

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: I don't care who we're up against — Stacko and I ain't gonna lose!

dialogues.speaker: Stacko
dialogues.text: Beep-beep!

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Let's strike first! Stacko, "Formation Shift"!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ohh! The robot has kicked things off with a change of formation. But how will this affect the battle? Nobody knows!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Attack.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The other party chooses to attack! Let's see how their partner performs!

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Beep.

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Stacko...!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The attack lands! And if those sizzling sounds are anything to go by, it was very effective!

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Okay then... Stacko, maintain formation, and enter your empowered state!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Empowered state! There we go, now we're talking!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Absorbing the immense kuuvahki present on Moon-Prayer Night, this lean mean machine has greatly increased its offensive power!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Attack.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Good choice! Buffs count for nothing if you beat 'em before they can use it!

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Beep.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's a hit! But Stacko stands firm...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The battle is heating up, fast! I'm about to start sweating machine oil over here!

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Go for it, Stacko! Set kuuvahki to maximum!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Can their opponents withstand this blow? And what will this Moon Goddess do?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Don't be afraid. Fight however you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's... it's a Moonlane!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: A deft use of a Moonlane allows the kuuhenki to dodge the blow... and now it's spiraling around its foe in circles!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: One loop... Two loops...! The robot's screen is bugging out — it's getting dizzy!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What the... The Rimehorn Deer's antlers are glowing!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It absorbs the kuuvahki from its opponent... and uses that same power to deal a devastating counter attack!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: There goes the robot's formation!

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Beep.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: And... it's the empowered state!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Both robots empowered now... the attack comes in, but oh! Attacks repelled! Opposites attract, but likes repel, and now you've seen it in action!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What a powerful repulsion! The robot crashes into the wall! Can it keep going?

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Stacko...!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Stacko is down for the count. Our winner is... the Moon Goddess! Uh, the slightly taller one, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: You did your best, Stacko. I'll take you to Aino's for a checkup right away, don't you worry.

dialogues.speaker: Stacko
dialogues.text: Beep...

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, you beat me fair and square, I guess... Honestly, I underestimated you. Won't make that mistake again.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I think my partner deserves most the credit.

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: Hmm... Just you wait! When I'm a little bit older, I'm gonna come back a whole lot stronger! Be ready for a rematch!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Hmm, I don't have enough data. Need more samples... But who should I ask for help?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Is this... one of the amusements? Or is it a research project?

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Bit of Column A, bit of Column B!

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: I'm currently running some synchronization tests on these bots...

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Basically, you need to press the button to help them successfully obtain the treasure — but you've gotta time it right.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: I'll record your data, which will be used to improve the robots' accuracy.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: But, Ma'am... I mean, Moon Goddess, don't you think you should take your eye mask off first?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: There's no need. I will be alright.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Okay then. Whatever you're comfortable with.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ready when you are.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Great, then let's begin.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Would you like to try again? I'll record your data, which will be used to improve the robots' accuracy.

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Cool! So much useful data... I'm progressing much faster than I expected!

dialogues.speaker: Liouba
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Moon Goddess.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: If this were any other day, I'm sure it would make for a great photo opportunity. But Moon-Prayer Night has rendered my antlers uncomfortably large...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Doesn't it look like... this Rimehorn Deer has two sets of antlers?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And, done! Here, take a look!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: ...I think it looks quite funny.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon thinks it's super cute!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like... a silly Chic Badger and... a Rimehorn Deer that's about to fall asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Silly? In what way?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm. Maybe I'll stand on the Chic Badger's side instead.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: It looks like we've attracted the attention of quite a few animals... Let's make room for them.

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: Goodness gracious! I've got to go back and tell my kids I took a photo with our great Moon Goddess!

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Moon Goddess!

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: It's a pity that my good friend, Faurobert is busy working on a training program for Princess Cimest.

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: If he could've been here, the victory might've been his.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow~

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I have a fish-flavor one if you'd like?

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Of course. If you prefer Mint, then Mint it is.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't mention it.

dialogues.speaker: Seija
dialogues.text: I'm gonna come back a whole lot stronger! Be ready for a rematch!

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: Miss Lyylikki, a kitten's been following you all this time.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Oh. So it has.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Hello there, little kitty. May the moon light your path.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Did Lady Lauma send you? Or was there something you needed?

dialogues.speaker: Sapphire
dialogues.text: Meow~

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Hmm? You'd like some Moon-Prayer Candies?

dialogues.speaker: Sapphire
dialogues.text: Meow~

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: No?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I believe... it wants that box. The one with the Moon-Prayer Candies in it.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: ...Ah, I see! Here, kitty, come on. Here you go.

dialogues.speaker: Sapphire
dialogues.text: Meow~

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Thank you, Lady...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Huh? Mr. Kantor, did you see that young lady dressed as the Moon Goddess? When did she leave?

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: Sorry, no, I was looking at... Um, I was watching the... cat.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: The resemblance was uncanny... She seemed like the true Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar, the one who guides souls...

dialogues.speaker: Jade-Eyed Cat
dialogues.text: Aren't you gonna sleep, winged ones?

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: No way! This is Moon-Prayer Night. No one sleeps on Moon-Prayer Night!

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: No one sleeeeeeeps! No one sleeeeeep, sleep-sleep sleep-sleep—

dialogues.speaker: Jade-Eyed Cat
dialogues.text: Shush! Be quiet. You're hurting my head with all that racket...

dialogues.speaker: Jade-Eyed Cat
dialogues.text: Wait a sec... That's the Moon Goddess. The real Moon Goddess! And she's looking this way...

dialogues.speaker: Jade-Eyed Cat
dialogues.text: Idiots! You're blocking her way!

dialogues.speaker: Sniffer Mole
dialogues.text: Brother, I've just been through a breakup... Console me, brother. Ease my aching heart.

dialogues.speaker: Sniffer Mole
dialogues.text: What was it you told me a while back? "The scent of love is in the air"...

dialogues.speaker: Sniffer Mole
dialogues.text: So I thought... but alas, 'twas but the scent of dirt in the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Sniffer Mole
dialogues.text: Oh yeah? Well, I'm sorry, but it sounds like your dumb nose is playing tricks on you.

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: How many times do I have to tell you? When you spin around, look up at the moon! The MOON, got it? Not at me! Do I look like a moon to you!?

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Sorry, Teacher!

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: And... again!

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Stop! ...You, at the back. You're behind the beat!

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: This dance is supposed to be simple! Focus up, or you'll be practicing till next Moon-Prayer Night at this rate! Again!

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Lemme guess, you're angry because of what I said, right? I can tell, because now you're going too fast! You're ahead of the beat!

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Sorry, Teacher... It's so noisy here, I... I can't hear the beat...

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Miss Kuuhenki? Um... Are you sure it's no trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Then thank you — yes, we'd love to have you play the accompaniment.

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Alright, look sharp everyone! Time to step it up! Show me your best moves!

dialogues.speaker: Moonglow Firefly
dialogues.text: Five, six, seven, eight!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Chestnut rolled a Hamster

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Happy Moon-Prayer Night!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Welcome home, Moon Goddess.

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: O, fair Moon Goddesses...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: So you think you know kuuhenki?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Come and check your knowledge with this kuuhenki quiz!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15948
dialogues.text: Cool!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15950
dialogues.text: I'm in!

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Question 1...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: What are kuuhenki? Are they:

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: The Moon Goddess's Pets? Her familiars? Or...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: ...Incarnations of the Moon Goddess Herself?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15948
dialogues.text: I know, I know!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15948
dialogues.text: They're pets!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15950
dialogues.text: Noooo, it's incarnations!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15949
dialogues.text: Umm... familiars?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: The correct answer is... familiars.

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Now then, here's the next question...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Which hobby do kuuhenki enjoy? Is it...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Playing musical instruments?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Fishing in the sea?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Or dancing?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15948
dialogues.text: I know, I know!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15948
dialogues.text: It's playing musical instruments! I know 'cause I just saw!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15950
dialogues.text: Wait, I thought it was dancing?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15949
dialogues.text: They like all three!

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: The correct answer is... playing musical instruments.

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: This Moon Goddess is very observant indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Now then, here's the next question...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: If you meet a kuuhenki, what should you do?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Follow their guidance?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Make friends with them?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Or help them solve a problem?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15948
dialogues.text: All three!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15950
dialogues.text: I'd make friends!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15949
dialogues.text: I think all three as well!

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: The correct answer is... all three!

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Kuuhenki like to guide people...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: So if you do meet one, it's can't hurt to follow here and see what happens!

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: But as gentle-hearted Moon Goddesses...

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: Be sure to be kind to every kuuhenki you meet...

dialogues.speaker: Jacek
dialogues.text: Dodoco's awesome adventure is about to begin! We wish everyone a wonderful journey!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#16231
dialogues.text: Wow, this looks like so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#16232
dialogues.text: I wanna ride too! Let's go together!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15946
dialogues.text: That was so fun!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15947
dialogues.text: Great!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15942
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15943
dialogues.text: I wanna go again!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15944
dialogues.text: Dodoco's the best!

dialogues.speaker: Jacek
dialogues.text: Dodoco's awesome adventure has come to a close. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15945
dialogues.text: I'm afraid of heights...

dialogues.speaker: Stream
dialogues.text: How about... we ride together?

dialogues.speaker: Padisarah
dialogues.text: Wow! It looks really fun!

dialogues.speaker: Kaarina
dialogues.text: I like sunny days!

dialogues.speaker: Lemetti
dialogues.text: Hmm... the day or the night...

dialogues.speaker: Koski
dialogues.text: Robot, reinforce the armor with kuuvahki! Ha, let's see you try to hit me now!

dialogues.speaker: Arkhyp
dialogues.text: You sneaky old geezer! Fine, I'll play along. Robot, open those eyes wide and give it a good scare!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#16266
dialogues.text: Beep beep! (Defense boosted!)

dialogues.speaker: NPC#16262
dialogues.text: Beep beep! (The opponent's defense is down!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which one should Paimon choose?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, this one it is!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I'm going with this one!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I'll pick this one.

dialogues.speaker: Citrus
dialogues.text: We should have two flagons of Magic Tonic to celebrate!

dialogues.speaker: Cranberry
dialogues.text: Woohoo, that was fun!

dialogues.speaker: Chestnut
dialogues.text: I didn't even win one round...

dialogues.speaker: Chestnut
dialogues.text: Yes! I finally won!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: (Where should I go first...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: (This must be the mages' stall... It feels like I've entered a fairytale. Ah, how lovely.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: (There are so many attractions here... Since I rarely get out, I might as well make the most of it.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: (So this is the Frostmoon Scions' area? It feels very familiar... but everyone looks much happier than usual.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: (What's this...? Hmm. Should I give it a try?)

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph. Allow me to demonstrate since I'm feeling so nice. You just step on the teeth — like this.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: There are less and less teeth remaining...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that noise...

dialogues.speaker: Padisarah
dialogues.text: (Here comes the ring! Oh, peanuts...)

dialogues.speaker: Wheel
dialogues.text: (Change tracks!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Go on.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I win.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I have a pair.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Good luck, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Go, go! Fly!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Phew! That was too close. I thought I was gonna lose...

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: And the winner is Chestnut! Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Ding dong. The next robot show will start in five minutes. We thank you for your patience.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The robot show will now begin.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Please welcome to the stage "Cool Your Jets Ducky."

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Combining precision engineering with water-cooling technology, this high-performance sprinkler fires powerful, controlled balls of water for up to fourteen seconds at a time.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: As well as providing accurate plant-watering at range, it can also be used to clean those tough-to-reach areas of the house that Aino cannot get to, no matter how high she jumps.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Show us what you can do, Cool Your Jets Ducky.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Dealing with stage waterlogging... Task complete.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Next up, we have "Knuckle Duckle."

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This armed domestic robot utilizes multi-sensor fusion technology to provide 24-hour security and environmental parameter monitoring.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Duster Mode redefines the meaning of dusting, providing our Krumpanions with a holistic, thorough, and effective cleaning service for the long term.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Take it away, Knuckle Duckle.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Clearing stage of Kuuvahki Stamping Die... Task complete.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now, let's see what "Krum-Clank 70% Sweet" can do for you.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This dessert-making robot fully automates the baking process with smart recipe analysis and precision temperature control.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Don't miss out on Krum-Clank's taste-testing function. Unique to the market, it is a hallmark of Aino's forward-thinking design philosophy, which places mechanical empathy at the core.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Krum-Clank 70% Sweet, the stage is yours.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Converting excess desserts into energy... Conversion complete.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now showcasing "Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1."

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This stealth robot boasts silent propulsion and low-center-of-gravity stabilization technology, enabling rapid infiltration into high-risk environments.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: For obstacle removal on a large scale, it represents an upgrade from more traditional cleaning units. However, it is not recommended for bedroom use as the spinning circular saw may cause damage to furniture.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Over to you, Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Activating kuuvahki acceleration field... Activation complete.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The next showcase is everyone's favorite prospector bot, "Chard Lombro."

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I'm not a "prospector bot"! I'm the "Trash King"!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This is a special sorting bot that can sift through useless trash and pick out valuable treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Its manufacturing history remains a mystery, but Aino and I are both delighted that it has joined the Craftshop family.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I'm not!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now, how about a demo, "Chard"?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: How about some trash to sort!? There's none here!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Note how it can simulate temper tantrums and respond to information in real time.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Take me back to the workshop! I want to work!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now that's what I call true power. What a demonstration.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Now syncing navigation route with Little Chard... Sync complete.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This time, we are proud to present... "Ineffa." That's me.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I am a multifunctional robot for domestic application, integrating smart cleaning, precision cooking, emotive communication, and various other modules.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: When necessary, I can autonomously deploy the multipurpose smart assistance unit, "Birgitta," to ensure the safety of important personnel.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...This includes the just-in-time pickup of candy wrappers and similar items, to prevent Aino from tripping over them.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa! You weren't supposed to mention that!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Acknowledged. Proceeding to demonstration phase.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And we don't need a Birgitta demo! Everyone's seen her already!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Roger. Amending demonstration program... Moonlane detected. Kuuvahki ready.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino, let's go home.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: W—Wait, that's not what I meant...!

dialogues.text: Paimon picked Luonnotar and hid her in a box.

dialogues.text: It seemed Aino couldn't form a pair with the kuuhenki, so she hid it back into a box.

dialogues.text: And the winner is Chestnut! Congratulations!
